name: TransSahara Misrata Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists a Misrata facility at Tripoli St 025 and reports TransSahara operates commercial cloud/VM/backup/DRaaS data centers in Libya; capacity reported by directory as 1 MW.

name: LPTIC digital transformation data center - Misrata
developer: Libyan Post, Telecommunications and Information Technology Company (LPTIC)
notes: LPTIC digital transformation page states the program includes setting up comprehensive data centers in Tripoli and Misrata; no capacity or commissioning date found.

name: Murzuq Municipal Data Center / Governance Data Hub
developer: UNDP Libya, Fezzan University, Murzuq Municipality
notes: UNDP RFQ UNDP-LBY-00644 seeks to revitalize and complete the Murzuq municipal data center hosted at Fezzan University and transition it into a governance data hub.

name: Sebha Municipality-University Data Center / Multi-Stakeholder Data Hub
developer: UNDP Libya, Sabha Municipality, local university partners
notes: UNDP RFQ describes successful rehabilitation of the Municipality-University Data Center in Sebha and a 2026 phase to scale it into a unified multi-stakeholder data hub.

name: TransSahara Sabha Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists a TransSahara Sabha facility on Jamal Abdelnaser Street and describes TransSahara commercial cloud/VM/backup/DRaaS data center operations in Libya; no capacity found.

name: LTT Internet Data Center (IDC)
notes: Directories reproduce LTT's announcement of the LTT Internet Data Center in Tripoli and describe redundant generators and multiple independent links; no capacity found.

name: TransSahara-Tatweer Tier 3 Data Center
notes: 2019 Libya Herald and DCD reports announced a Tier 3/Huawei FusionModule1000A data center for Tripoli, operated by TransSahara with Tatweer; Libya Monitor headline reports Trans Sahara launched a data center on 2022-02-04.

name: Qabas Tripoli Data Centers
notes: Qabas describes Tripoli-based data centers with backup generators, independent internet links, security, fire detection/suppression, colocation, cloud services, and private enterprise solutions.

name: Qabas new state-of-the-art Tripoli data center
notes: Qabas states expansion plans include a new Tripoli data center projected to be operational by mid-2025; no separate completion confirmation found during this batch search.

name: University of Tripoli Faculty of IT Data Center
developer: University of Tripoli; donated by Almadar Aljadid and Huawei Libya
notes: University of Tripoli announced completion of a data center installation within the Faculty of IT, donated by Almadar Aljadid and Huawei, to support practical IT student work.

name: Al-Madar Al-Jadid Tripoli data center / root server site
developer: Al-Madar Al-Jadid Company; General Authority for Communications and Informatics
notes: Libya Herald reports Libya launched root server infrastructure through operating sites in data centres of Al-Madar Al-Jadid in Tripoli and Benghazi; LPTIC confirms Almadar operates from Tripoli.
